prompt_extra.STYLE: Ink and gouache, dark contours, neutral daylight. The only attached picture is the campus map, and it supplies the doorway's building. Do not copy the red-brick lycée from that map.
prompt_extra.LIGHT AND COLOR: White stone, cream floor, true colors. No amber, orange, sepia, pink, or blue cast over the room. The orange pot and purple crystal are local objects only.
prompt_extra.COMPOSITION: Three separated pairs with open floor between them: stone and earth sack on the left, a small mine model left of the mineral cluster, boot tray and crucible and pendulum and crystal spaced across the right. No empty placement diagram is attached. Objects may sit well inside their envelopes.
prompt_extra.PLACEMENT AND SPACING: Feminine group centers stay near 20 percent. The adjective center stays near 48 percent. Masculine group centers stay past 65 percent. Keep a wide gap around every group so a drift still leaves the center on the correct side of 45 or 55 percent and the whole helper inside the 6 percent margin.
prompt_extra.DOORS AND EXITS: The open doors show this faculty as it appears on the attached campus map. Do not invent a red-brick frame.
prompt_extra.FIGURES: No people, no children, no dwarf, no mime. One teacup-sized mouse at the crystal, one ladybird on the pendulum bob, one worm in the soil. Each creature is entirely inside its own envelope and smaller than the object it accompanies.
prompt_extra.TEXT: No letters, numbers, labels, or speech anywhere. The plaque over the door is blank.
prompt_extra.CONTENT: All ages. The crucible flame is small and steady on a trivet, with no person and no child near it. No explosion, acid, weapon, or danger.
